Read the full disclosureQuoted from the Steam store page

Generative AI was used during the early stages of character and background artwork production to explore initial concepts, expressions, poses, and compositions.

AI-generated content was used only for early drafts and reference materials. The final character and background artwork was completed through direct redrawing by artists, including poses, compositions, expressions, anatomy, clothing and props, colors, and detailed designs.

Generative AI was also used in the production of some background music. All AI-assisted content was created in advance during development, and no generative AI is used during gameplay.
